pageCache.pageTitle: Welcome from the Headteacher - King's Academy Northern Parade
pageCache.text:
Welcome from the Headteacher
A message from the Headteacher
Welcome to King’s Academy Northern Parade! I am thrilled to welcome you to our vibrant and inclusive school community. As Headteacher, my passion lies in ensuring that every child feels seen, valued, and included. Creating a sense of belonging and meeting the unique needs of each child is at the very heart of everything we do.
At Northern Parade, we believe every child is wonderfully unique. Our mission is to provide a nurturing environment where all children feel safe, inspired, and supported to reach their full potential whether academically, socially, creatively, or personally.
Our approach goes beyond academic achievements. We aim to help children grow in confidence, discover their strengths, and develop essential life skills. From the classroom to the sports field, and through creative opportunities, we are dedicated to empowering every child to shine in their own way.
Happiness and inclusion are central to our vision. We are proud of our dedicated and passionate staff who work tirelessly to ensure every child feels part of our school family. Safeguarding and well-being are paramount to us, ensuring this is a place where children can thrive and grow in a supportive environment.
Together, we will nurture your child’s journey, instilling values of kindness, respect, and resilience that will guide them far beyond their time with us. I am deeply committed to working in partnership with you to create the best possible future for your child.
Thank you for entrusting us with this important chapter in your child’s life. I look forward to meeting you and working together to ensure your child’s experience at Northern Parade is one of joy, growth, and success.

pageCache.pageTitle: School Meals and Menus - King's Academy Northern Parade
pageCache.text:
School Meals and Menus
Menu
Parents have the choice as to whether they wish their child to have a school hot dinner or a home packed lunch.
The health and wellbeing of our children is extremely important and we work hard to ensure that this is reflected in every aspect of School life.
We are very proud to have achieved the ‘Healthy Schools’ status, part of which is to promote healthy eating.
Please note we do not allow nuts of any kind / peanut butter sandwiches in school due to some of our children having a strong allergy to nuts.
Payment
To pay for your child's meal please click here to use our online payment system.
I would like to pay, please
Free School Meals
“Free School Meals” are available to pupils whose parents are in receipt of Income Support, Jobseekers Allowance or Child Tax Credit (Working Tax Credit does NOT apply). The necessary forms and approval can be obtained through the school office. The till operator will ensure those entitled pupils get their meal.
Free School Meals eligibility
Packed Lunches
We have come up with a handy guide to help you provide the most nutritious lunch options for your child.
For those pupils who do not wish to have a school hot dinner, we will accommodate them eating a packed lunch. We expect a named plastic container to be provided and ask that meals brought to the school are substantial enough to last a child throughout the day and follow our Healthy Schools campaign.
Unfortunately, we cannot dispose of packed lunch rubbish, therefore the pupils will bring their rubbish home, so please make sure containers are cleaned daily.

pageCache.pageTitle: Service Families and Premium - King's Academy Northern Parade
pageCache.text:
Service Families and Premium
Welcome to our Service Families page. Here you will be able to find information about our Service Club and events that we will be holding.
I am Mrs Rose, I am the Headteachers PA at KANP and I am also a Military wife. I understand the challenges that come with deployments and the importance of feeling part of a community during periods of separation. I can't wait to get involved with the club and to help create a fun and supportive network for our service families.
If you would like to contact a member of the team please email service.club@kingsacademies.uk
Deploying soon?
If you are going on deployment please let us know. If you have an email address that we could have too whilst you're away this would be really helpful. This way we can help your child email you whilst you are away. We can also make short video messages from your child to send to you.
Meet our Deployment Bears
We hope that these bears will get to travel the world with parents on deployment.
Service Club
Our Service Club runs every Tuesday after school until 4.10pm. During these sessions, children have the opportunity to socialise with other children who have a parent serving in the armed forces. They will learn about different roles within the armed forces and learn about different locations around the world where their parents may be serving. They will take part in activities including pebble painting and creating a service children board showing all the different locations their parents may have visited. There will be stories about separation anxiety and helping service children feel less isolated. We also have some trips and visits planned.

Uniform
School Uniform
It is incredibly important to us for the uniform to act as a social leveller, which is why we are asking for no branding/logos (e.g. Nike, Adidas etc) on items of clothing worn into school. These items should be reserved for wearing outside the school.
As you can imagine, for a school of our size, labelling of all clothing is vital.
All pupils are expected to only use a navy blue book bag or small navy blue backpack to transport key items to and from school (i.e. homework, reading books, and letters), a navy blue PE bag and use an appropriate lunch box.
You can access the online shop for our supplier Price and Buckland below:

Rooted in core skills while celebrating creativity and curiosity, we provide every child with the knowledge and experiences they need to thrive. Through a broad and balanced approach, we nurture confident, independent learners ready to take on the world.
